However, several critical gaps remain: (1) The Middlesex-London Health Unit's own official outbreak update pages beyond July 14 have not been directly surfaced (only one healthunit.com result appeared); (2) The Public Health Ontario 2025 surveillance PDF is the single most authoritative source but only snippets are available — additional PHO situation reports or interim bulletins may exist; (3) The govdelivery.com result (likely a health unit email alert) and outbreaknewstoday.substack.com result were accepted but not summarized — these may contain dated case counts; (4) The canada.ca results were not summarized and may contain PHAC notifiable disease data for Ontario July 2025; (5) The outbreak timeline spans late June through at least late July, so additional dated status updates (July 21, July 28, July 31) from the Middlesex-London Health Unit are likely to exist and would provide time-series case/death data within the July 2025 window; (6) The beaconbio.org results reference a Toronto cluster in 2026 (out of scope) and a London Ontario event — these need disambiguation; (7) No ProMED-specific result was surfaced, suggesting that channel may not have returned results. Iteration 2 should focus on: (a) Middlesex-London Health Unit direct outbreak update pages for all July 2025 status updates; (b) PHAC/canada.ca notifiable disease data for Ontario; (c) Additional news coverage with specific dated case counts (CBC London, London Free Press, CTV London); (d) The govdelivery/content.govdelivery result which likely is a health unit email alert with precise counts.
decision.coverage_assessment: Partial. The core outbreak (Middlesex-London, July 2025) is confirmed via snippets from healthunit.com (July 14 update: 66 cases, 2 deaths), crisis24.com (July 29: 70 cases, 2 deaths), beaconbio.org (94 cases, 4 deaths at re-declaration), and CBC (≈100 cases, 4 deaths, outbreak declared over). The PHO 2025 annual surveillance PDF is present and highly authoritative. The canada.ca and govdelivery results were not summarized and may contain additional data points.
decision.source_diversity_assessment: Good diversity across official agency (PHO PDF, healthunit.com), national news (CBC, CTV), risk intelligence (crisis24), and disease surveillance aggregator (beaconbio). Missing: London Free Press (local paper most likely to have granular dated updates), PHAC canada.ca notifiable disease tables, and additional Middlesex-London Health Unit status update pages beyond July 14. decision.trustworthiness_assessment: High for the core outbreak signal. healthunit.com (Middlesex-London Health Unit official site), publichealthontario.ca (PHO annual surveillance report), ctvnews.ca (established Canadian broadcaster), cbc.ca (national public broadcaster), and crisis24.com (professional risk intelligence) are all credible. beaconbio.org is a disease intelligence aggregator — useful for cross-referencing but secondary to official sources. The beaconbio Toronto 2026 result is out of scope and must be excluded. youtube.com and linkedin.com/facebook.com results should be deprioritized. The govdelivery.com result is likely an official health unit email notification and is trustworthy if confirmed as such.
decision.disease_location_time_fit_assessment: Strong fit. The outbreak is explicitly located in Middlesex-London Health Unit (London, Ontario), which is within Ontario. The July 14 and July 29 data points fall squarely within the July 2025 window. The PHO snippet references "late June and early July" as the peak period. The CBC snippet notes the July outbreak "has since been declared over" with 4 deaths and ~100 cases — this is consistent with an outbreak that began in late June/early July and concluded within or shortly after July 2025. The 94-case/4-death figure from beaconbio (re-declaration) may extend into August, requiring careful date attribution. The CTV snippet ("43 cases confirmed so far in 2025") appears to be an earlier data point, possibly from the initial outbreak declaration, which may predate July 1 — this needs disambiguation via follow-up queries.
decision.corroboration_potential_assessment: Strong corroboration potential exists. Multiple independent sources (health unit, PHO, CBC, CTV, crisis24, beaconbio) all point to the same Middlesex-London outbreak. The case counts across sources are consistent with a progression (43 → 66 → 70 → 94 → ~100), suggesting these are dated snapshots. Iteration 2 queries targeting the health unit's own update pages and local news will likely surface additional dated snapshots that corroborate and extend the time series within July 2025.

decision.corroboration_potential_assessment: High. The core case and death counts are corroborated across at least three independent source types: (1) the Middlesex-London Health Unit's own official outbreak update pages (healthunit.com); (2) the Public Health Ontario 2025 annual surveillance PDF (publichealthontario.ca); (3) multiple credible news outlets (cbc.ca, ctvnews.ca, crisis24.com); and (4) the London Health Sciences Centre media statement (lhsc.on.ca). The July 14 figure (66 cases/2 deaths) is confirmed by the healthunit.com direct update page. The July 11 figure (43 cases/1 death) is confirmed by beaconbio citing the outbreak declaration. This multi-source corroboration is sufficient for reliable data extraction.
